Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Does the combination

Aggro damage + Rotschreck beat S:CE?

Example:

Minion A strikes S:CE
Minion B strikes with aggro damage
Meth controlling Minion B wants to play Rotschreck thus sending the
opposing minion to torpor.

Is this legal?

Michael Beer

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Rotschreck is played when the aggravated-damage-dealing-attempt is
announced - which in this case is before strike reoslution, so before
S:CE can resolve.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
sh...@leme.anu.edu.au wrote:
> Can Rotschreck be played on an aggravated hand strike which is dealing
> 0 damage be of erosion, disease, song of serenity, disarm or whatever?

No, since attempting to use zero aggravated damage doesn't count
as attempting to use aggravated damage (just as successfully
bleeding for zero doesn't count as successfully bleeding).
